reviews.text: not at all what i was hoping for. its a whisper of glitter in gold or pink. its fine, but i was expecting bold and shiny. i tried it as an eyeshadow and as a highlight, just a light speckling of glitter.
reviews.zh: 完全唔係我期望嘅效果。係金色或者粉紅色嘅淡淡閃粉。都幾好，不過我原本期望係大膽又閃亮嘅效果。我試過用嚟做眼影同埋提亮，只係淡淡嘅閃粉點綴。

reviews.text: Hermosas sombras! me encanta el concepto de dúos compactos. Ideales para llevar de viaje. Elegí un tono que es cierto dupe a la sombra cowboy de U.D. La pigmentación es preciosa. Estoy tentada a comprar otras paletas de la marca.
reviews.zh: 好靚嘅眼影！我好鍾意呢種細細盒嘅雙色設計，啱晒帶去旅行。我揀咗一款，好似 U.D. 嘅 cowboy 眼影嘅真正平替。上色好靚。我好想再買呢個品牌其他嘅眼影盤。

reviews.text: I got shade #06 Golden Bronze and it’s such a pretty combination of warm, wearable shades. The palette is really compact, so it’s easy to keep in a makeup bag or take while travelling. I especially love the shimmer shades, they catch the light beautifully without looking too much. The colours work really well together for a simple everyday eye look. Such a cute little palette and I’m really happy with this one!
reviews.zh: 我買咗 #06 Golden Bronze，係一個好靚嘅暖色調組合，好易配搭日常化妝。眼影盤好細，好容易放喺化妝袋或者旅行時攜帶。我特別鍾意閃亮嘅色號，佢哋反光好漂亮，又唔會太誇張。啲顏色配搭得好好，可以化簡單嘅日常眼妝。好得意嘅一盤小眼影，我好滿意呢款！

reviews.text:
Lo que más adoro del producto es que sea en un tamaño compacto y la pigmentación del producto, la forma más fácil de sacar el producto es un con aceite limpiador para que todas las particulas de glitter sean bien removidas del rostro.

Sin duda Unleashia es la mejor marca de maquillaje.
reviews.zh:
我最鍾意呢件產品嘅，係佢個 size 好細，而且上色好靚。最容易去除產品嘅方法，係用卸妝油，咁就可以將所有閃粉粒子徹底卸走，唔會留喺面上。

毫無疑問，Unleashia 係最好嘅化妝品牌。

reviews.text: Me gustan mucho que el producto sea pequeño y este gliter no me desepciono es lindo al momento en que lo usas se adiere muy bien a ala piel pero lo que mas me agrado es que lo puedes usar en distintas zonas del rostro.
reviews.zh: 我好鍾意呢件產品細細件，而且呢款閃粉冇令我失望。佢好靚，用嘅時候好服貼咁黏喺皮膚上，但係我最鍾意嘅係，你可以用喺面嘅唔同位置。

reviews.zh: 我通常會喺短途旅行或者坐飛機嗰陣帶呢類細細盒嘅眼影，我想帶啲化妝品，但知道自己會去趕啲嘢。佢哋嘅眼影好柔和，閃粉都好幼細，但好閃。我好鍾意

reviews.text: i got Mystic petal because I was really curious about that darker colour, did not disappoint ❤️ they are not veeeeery pigmented but still visible. the pink is a little bit metallic and the darker colour has a burgundy base (a little bit sheer) with blue/ teal glitters.
reviews.zh: 我買咗 Mystic petal，因為我好好奇嗰個較深嘅顏色，結果冇令我失望 ❤️ 佢哋上色唔係好濃，但仲係睇得到。粉紅色有少少金屬感，而深色嗰款底色係酒紅色（有少少通透），加埋藍色／青綠色嘅閃粉。

reviews.text: I love the colour ! The “Rose Veil” version’s combination of a marbled pearl-pink plus muted rose gives a soft, romantic vibe. It should suit rosy / cool-leaning skin tones nicely. The small size is convenient for travel or for throwing into a minimal makeup bag. so cute !
reviews.zh: 我好鍾意呢個顏色！「Rose Veil」版本嘅大理石珠光粉紅配搭柔和嘅玫瑰色，帶出柔和又浪漫嘅感覺。應該好啱偏粉紅色調／冷色調膚色嘅人。細細件，方便旅行，或者放入簡約嘅化妝袋都好方便。好得意！
